highlights.description: Initial release: a Go implementation of the OCSF standard covering schema compilation, generated bindings for every event class and object, semantic validation, and `record_integrity` cryptography
Generated from OCSF 1.10.0-dev, including the `win`, `linux`, and `macos` platform extensions
Compiled schema embedded in the module, so validation needs no OCSF checkout at runtime

added.description: [schema] Loader and compiler for OCSF's metaschema source format: `extends` flattening, `$include` profiles, dictionary type joins, platform extensions, external extension roots, class-UID computation, and observable enum synthesis
[gen] Go code generator emitting structs, enum constants, caption maps, and the class-UID registry from a compiled schema
[cmd/ocsfgen] Cobra CLI to regenerate bindings from any OCSF schema checkout, with `--extensions` and `--extension-dirs` flags
[ocsf/events, ocsf/objects] Generated event and object structs with caption lookup tables, observable type registries, and the `NewEventByClassUID` / `UnmarshalEvent` class-UID dispatcher
[ocsf/ocsfdata] Embedded compiled schema as indented JSON (`MustSchema()`) for runtime use without an OCSF checkout
[validate] Semantic validator: profile-aware required attributes, scalar types, enum membership, nested objects, `at_least_one`/`just_one` constraints, and class/category/type UID consistency

[recordintegrity] `record_integrity` profile cryptography: JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalization, content and chain fingerprints, ECDSA/RSA attestation signing, verification with a status taxonomy, and tamper-evident chain-link verification
[ocsfext/integrity] Schema extension adding `digital_signature.signature_value`, which OCSF 1.10.0-dev lacks; interim until upstream ocsf-schema#1698 lands an official attribute

documentation.description: README, MkDocs site, PRD/TRD/PLAN/ROADMAP specs, and upstream issue draft for ocsf-schema#1698
